description: Each Xero bank account's balance against the close of the previous business day, or any week or month you pick, with the transactions behind the change. Choose which accounts to include, sort or page the transactions, and set a balance to flag accounts against.

props.text: The opening balance is the close of the day before the first date.

props.text: Check the xero-accounting connection under Settings, then refresh the tile.
Accounts at or above this balance show a green dot. The threshold lasts for this visit only — reloading the page clears it.
Xero has more transactions in this window than the tile lists, so the rows below do not account for the whole change.
